faqs.question: What is file hosting?
faqs.answer:
File hosting is a service that allows businesses to upload, store, manage, and share files online. Instead of keeping files only on local systems or sending large attachments, businesses can host images, videos, PDFs, documents, and other assets and share them through accessible URLs.

MSG91 File Hosting provides a centralized platform to host business files and use them across WhatsApp, SMS, Email, RCS, websites, applications, and APIs.

faqs.question: What is a file hosting service?
faqs.answer:
A file hosting service provides online storage and access to files through a centralized platform. It helps businesses manage their digital assets and share them through hosted URLs instead of repeatedly uploading or sending the same files.

With MSG91, businesses can upload files once, generate shareable URLs, and reuse those files across customer communication and business workflows.

faqs.question: Why do businesses need a file hosting service?
faqs.answer:
Businesses often share the same files across multiple campaigns, customer conversations, websites, and applications. Managing those files separately can result in repeated uploads, scattered assets, outdated versions, and unnecessary manual work.

A file hosting service provides one centralized location where teams can upload, organize, and reuse business files through shareable URLs.

faqs.question: Which types of files can I host with MSG91?
faqs.answer:
MSG91 File Hosting supports a wide range of business file types, including:
• Images such as JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG, and WEBP
• Videos such as MP4, MOV, AVI, and MPEG
• Audio files such as MP3, WAV, AAC, and AMR
• Documents such as PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, and PPTX

The platform supports 100+ file formats, making it suitable for hosting marketing assets, business documents, product media, training resources, and customer-facing content.

faqs.question: Can I upload a file once and reuse it?
faqs.answer:
Yes. One of the key advantages of MSG91 File Hosting is the ability to upload a file once and reuse its hosted URL across different campaigns, communication channels, websites, applications, and workflows.

This helps teams reduce repetitive uploads and maintain consistent access to frequently used business assets.

faqs.question: Can file hosting be used with chatbots and automation?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Hosted file URLs can be integrated into chatbot responses and automated workflows to deliver relevant files based on customer interactions.

For example, a business can use a hosted URL to share a product brochure, user manual, invoice, onboarding document, or troubleshooting guide when a customer requests it.

faqs.question: How does a file hosting service help reduce repetitive work?
faqs.answer:
Without centralized file hosting, teams may repeatedly upload the same images, PDFs, videos, or documents whenever they create a new campaign or customer communication.

With MSG91, businesses can upload a file once, generate a hosted URL, and reuse it across supported channels and workflows. This reduces manual file management and helps teams launch communications faster.

faqs.question: Can I use the same hosted file across multiple channels?
faqs.answer:
Yes. A hosted file can be reused across supported business communication channels and digital touchpoints, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, RCS, websites, applications, and APIs.

This creates a centralized approach to managing communication assets instead of maintaining separate copies for every channel.

faqs.question: Is MSG91 File Hosting suitable for business communication?
faqs.answer:
Yes. MSG91 File Hosting is designed around business communication use cases where companies frequently need to share images, videos, documents, brochures, invoices, and other files with customers.

It connects file hosting with channels such as WhatsApp, SMS, Email, RCS, websites, applications, APIs, and automation workflows.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of using cloud file hosting for businesses?
faqs.answer:
Cloud file hosting gives businesses a centralized way to manage and share digital assets online. With MSG91, businesses can:
• Centralize frequently used files
• Upload files once and reuse them
• Generate shareable hosted URLs
• Reduce repetitive file uploads
• Share files across multiple communication channels
• Support automated file delivery
• Simplify file management for teams

faqs.question: Is file hosting useful for customer support?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Customer support teams can use hosted files to share troubleshooting guides, product manuals, setup instructions, warranty documents, FAQs, videos, policies, and other helpful resources.

Instead of searching for and attaching files during every conversation, teams can provide customers with ready-to-use hosted links.

faqs.question: Why choose MSG91 as your file hosting service?
faqs.answer:
MSG91 combines file hosting with business communication. Instead of managing files separately from your communication workflows, businesses can host their assets and use them across WhatsApp, SMS, Email, RCS, websites, APIs, applications, chatbots, and automation workflows.

This makes MSG91 File Hosting a practical solution for businesses that need both centralized file management and easy file sharing.
